items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bill Bennett was a musician. He had a band that I was with temporarily.

ctx.x: Bill Bennett was a musician. He had a band that I was with temporarily. I don’t know... I remember playing with him a couple of times.

But during those couple of years, you’re doing various gigs—Mississippi, perhaps Memphis, because you’ve spoken about starting to go to Memphis in ‘47-‘48, not so far away from Tippo... Are you dividing your time between the piano and the trumpet?
